text: __NOTOC__ Mawsworn Interrogators are Maw necromancers located in the Seeker's Quorum of Korthia.
Mawsworn Charger's Reins is a Mawhorse mount, rewarded for earning the Flawless Master (Layer 12) achievement in Torghast, Tower of the Damned by 5-starring all six wings on layer 12.
Mawsworn Minion is a Maw guard combat pet that drops from Kel'Thuzad in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Ritual Book drops from any Crucible Magus at the Crucible of the Damned. Lord Herne wants one for Looming Darkness during the Night Fae Assault.

Mawsworn Abductors are kyrian located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald. If at any point the Maw Walker should stray too far from the battle, they will grab them and bring them back to the action.
Mawsworn Eradicators are mawsworn located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Mawsworn Raiders are Maw guards located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald. One is also seen in the Maw by the road to Korthia during Mysteries of the Maw.
Maw Portals are located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald. They are maintained by Mawsworn Gatekeepers.
Mawsworn Realmbinders are kyrian located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Mawsworn Invokers are Maw casters located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Mawsworn Pillagers are Maw guards located in Ardenweald during The Battle of Ardenweald.
Mawsworn Assaulters are Maw casters located all around the airspace of Oribos during Report to Oribos. They are seen bombarding the barrier put up by Jaina Proudmoore at the western entrance.
Mawsworn Houndmasters are Maw guards located in the Maw during the Escape from the Maw. They are also seen marching into Korthia during Mysteries of the Maw.
Mawsworn Brutalizers are charred behemoths located in the Maw. They are seen marching into Korthia during Mysteries of the Maw.
The Maw Snakeskin Boots drop from Ikras the Devourer in the Maw.
The Mawsworn Exterminator's Hauberk drops from the Towering Exterminator in Korthia.
The Mawsworn Lieutenant's Treads drop from the Towering Exterminator in Korthia.
Mawsworn Mutilators are Mawsworn constructs located in the Scholar's Den in Korthia.
Mawsworn Eviscerator's Cuirass is dropped by the Eye of the Jailer in the Sanctum of Domination.
The Maw Construct's Shoulderguards drop from the Carriage Crusher in the Beastwarrens in The Maw.
Mawsworn Enforcer's Shoulder-Spires are looted from Mawsworn Cache.
The Mawsworn Herald's Vestments drop from Dathlane the Herald in The Maw.
Mawforged Constructs are Mawsworn construct located in the Maw.
Mawsworn Scryers are Maw casters located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Rageguards are Maw guards located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Paindrinkers are Maw casters located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Maw Assassins are Maw necromancers located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Lancers are Mawsworn kyrian located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Infusers are Mawsworn kyrian located in the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Corruptors are Maw necromancers located in Scholar's Den in Korthia.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Regulators are Mawsworn constructs located in the Crucible of the Damned in the Maw.
Mawsworn Assassin's Twinblade is a world drop from the Maw, Korthia, and the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Darkcaster's Stave is a world drop from the Maw, Korthia, and the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Collector's Gavel is a world drop from the Maw, Korthia and the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Battle Hammer is a world drop from the Maw, Korthia and the Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Sentry's Cudgel drops from Soul Reaver, Mawsworn Sentry and Mawsworn Interrogator in Korthia.
Mawsworn Scout's Coif drops from Soul Reaver in Sanctum of Domination.
Mawsworn Assassin's Doublet drops from Lumisende, Naelcrotix, Zograthos and Dathlane the Herald in The Maw.
Mauler's Weapon-Hauling Belt drops from Commander Dro'gan and Annihilon in Lunarfall.
Mawsworn Protectors are Maw guards encountered by adventure companions in the Planes of Torment in the Maw and Bastion.

__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Blackguards are Maw necromancers located in the Maw. These units serve as targets for Who Sent You?, which was made difficult after the removal of the Eye of the Jailer (mechanic) mechanic when completing Focusing the Eye in the Chains of Domination campaign.
__NOTOC__ Mawforged Bridle is looted from the High Value Cache in the Sepulcher of the First Ones and has a small chance to be contained in Olea Cache.
Mawsworn Hulks are Mawsworn constructs located in Zereth Mortis.
Mawsworn Purgers are Mawsworn construct located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Heralds are Mawsworn kyrian located in Zereth Mortis.
Mawsworn Binders are Maw casters located in the Great Veldt and in the cave with Otaris the Provoked in Zereth Mortis.
Mawforged Weapons Cache is sold by Broker Ve'ken and Broker Ve'nott in Torghast, Tower of the Damned for .
Maw Destructors are Mawsworn devices located in the Great Veldt in Zereth Mortis. They are bombarding the shield around Haven.
Mawsworn Oppressors are Maw guards located in Zereth Mortis.
Mawsworn Converters are Maw casters located in Zereth Mortis.
Mawsworn Inquisitors are Maw casters located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Chargers are Maw guards located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Plunderers are Maw guards located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ The Maw-Frenzied Lupine is a lupine located in the Choral Residium in Zereth Mortis. During Surveying Cyphers, it is seen threatening the Mysterious Automa.
Mawsworn Disruptors are Maw casters located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Flametenders are Maw casters located in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. They also appear in the Maw.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Eyerippers are Maw guards located at the Vault of Secrets in Korthia.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Cleavers are Maw guards located at the Vault of Secrets in Korthia.

__NOTOC__ The Mawbound Memories are memories that spawn from Anduin Wrynn in Bastion's Chamber of First Reflection during What Makes Us Strong (quest). At first only three of them spawn, but then more of them begin spawning faster and faster until Anduin is forced to interrupt the ritual and Jaina Proudmoore kills all of the memories with a Frost Nova. Luckily, they deal next to no damage to the player.
__NOTOC__ The Mawbound Monstrosity is a large memory that spawns from Anduin Wrynn in Bastion's Chamber of First Reflection during What We Overcome.
Mawsworn Cryptoseers are Maw casters located in the Great Veldt in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Aggressors are Maw guards located in Zereth Mortis.
Mawsworn Annihilators are Mawsworn constructs located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Defilers are Maw casters located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsworn Provokers are Maw casters located in Zereth Mortis.
__NOTOC__ Mawsteel Shards are found throughout Zovaal's Grasp in Zereth Mortis.

Maw of Corruption is a cave on the Coast of Anguish in the south on the Broken Shore. The cave is typically populated with an Imp Mother, unleashing imps forth. When Creeping Fel is active, eredar led by Morzuun the Plaguebringer are found within.
__NOTOC__ Mature Scalecrawlers are beetles located at the Old Weyrn Grounds in the Forbidden Reach.
Mature White Bell can be found along the coast of the Waking Shores.
Mature Basilisks are basilisks located along the south-eastern shores of the Waking Shores.
Maul of Smiting is a starting item for allied race paladins.
Maul of the Earthshaper drops from the Primal Council in the Vault of the Incarnates.
The Mature Slasher is a red wylderdrake located at the northeastern edge of the Flashfrost Assault in the Waking Shores. It is periodically attacked by a Primal Avalanche.
Maw Stalker drops from the following bosses in Torghast, Tower of the Damned: *Observer Zelgar *The Grand Malleare *Arch-Suppressor Laguas *Cellblock Sentinel
Maw Crawler drops from the following bosses in Torghast, Tower of the Damned: *Kosarus the Fallen *Writhing Soulmass *Gherus the Chained
Maul of Raging Tempests is sold by Mythressa for and Rethelshi in Valdrakken for .

Matthew Yang King is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions. He couldn't reprise his job as Illidan in World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade due to guild union issues.

Matt "Burnzerker" Burns is a senior writer, associate publishing developer and story developer for Blizzard Entertainment. He has written for the company's Warcraft, StarCraft, Diablo, Hearthstone, and Overwatch settings. He started writing at Blizzard during Wrath of the Lich King, with his first assignment being the Violet Hold backstory on the old World of Warcraft website.
Matthew Mercer is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.

Matt Sanders is a Lead Exterior Level Lesigner on the World of Warcraft environment team. Along with Kelli Hoover, Sanders was responsible for creating the environment of the Spires of Arak zone, based on concept art by Jimmy Lo.
Matthew Morris is a Blizzard employee and is an exterior level designer for World of Warcraft as of September 2020.
Matt Lowe is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Matthew Waterson is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Matt Oconnor is a Senior Dungeon Texture and Concept Artist at Blizzard Entertainment since November 2013.
Mauro Cascioli is an artist who contributed artwork for the World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game and Hearthstone.
Matt McDaid is Lead Exterior Artist at Blizzard Entertainment. He notably worked on the Arcway dungeon.
__NOTOC__ The Mechanical Squirrel Box teaches you how to summon a Mechanical Squirrel companion.
The Mechanical Chicken is a mechanical chicken companion. It's a miniature version of the OOX homing robot, created by master gnomish engineer Oglethorpe Obnoticus.
Meat is one of World of Warcrafts six main types of food. Meat in WoW represents the edible flesh of beasts and similar animals. The edible flesh of fully aquatic animals falls under fish.
McGavan is a human quest giver located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn. He is affiliated with the Mithril Order and used to send people to find Galvan the Ancient.
Mazthoril is a huge and deep icy cavern — populated by blue dragons — located near the central part of Winterspring, not far from Lake Kel'Theril or Everlook.
Mechanical Dragonling is a trinket that summons a mechanical dragonling guardian pet.
Mechanical Repair Kit is used to restore 700 health to a friendly mechanical target. Use this in emergencies or after you've had a huge fight.
__NOTOC__ Mazzranache is a rare tallstrider found in Mulgore, south-west of Thunder Bluff. He has a unique, pink skin.
Me'lynn is a night elf artisan tailoring trainer located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was caught in the chaos and could be saved.
__NOTOC__ A Meaty Bat Wing can be a great meal with a little seasoning.

Maywiki is a Zandalari troll quest giver located in the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn. Linzi Hewstrike was afraid that she was sad and lonely, so she asked an adventurer to give Maywiki a gift to make her feel better. Turned out that Maywiki wasn't lonely, she was just waiting for that particular adventurer. She later returned to Zandalar, and can be found at the Yojamba Exchange in Dazar'alor.
Mazk Snipeshot is a level 36 engineering supplies vendor located in Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn where he runs Boomstick Imports East.

__NOTOC__ Maxan Anvol is a dwarf priest trainer located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. As a priest of the Light, Maxan tests young students on their skills. If the students measure up to what Anvol thinks is good enough, he rewards them with robes 'denoting their place in the church'. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
__NOTOC__ Maximillion is a Forsaken warlock trainer located in Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

Maybell Maclure is a human quest giver located at the Maclure Vineyards in Elwynn Forest. Amidst a feud between the two families, Maybell has fallen in love with the heir of the Stonefield farmstead, Tommy Joe Stonefield. Her father, however, Pa Maclure forbids her to make any contact with the Stonefields. Despite this, she and Tommy Joe decide to meet in secret and, enlisting the help of Gramma Stonefield and the alchemist William Pestle, they procure an invisibility liquor, allowing Maybell to sneak away from the Maclure Vineyards and be with Tommy Joe for a short time. Since Warlords of Draenor, she can also be found at the barn in Lunarfall with several other members of the Stonefield fa
__NOTOC__ Mebok Mizzyrix is a goblin quest giver located in Ratchet in the Northern Barrens. He wanted to brew a "smart drink" out of raptor horns. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Mechanized Sentries are robotic gnomes mounted on mechanostriders that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance.
Mechano-Flamewalkers are elite mechano-tanks that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance.
Mechano-Frostwalkers are elite mechano-tanks that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance.
Mechano-Tanks are elite mechano-tanks that can be found in the Gnomeregan instance.
Mechano-Lord Capacitus is an optional arcane titan boss in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep. He is likely involved in the process of creating the manacells in the Mechanar.

.]] :"What the hell is that?" :"This crude contraption will allow you to transport the remains of our master." :— Arthas Menethil and an acolyte upon seeing a meat wagon One of the strangest and most dire tools utilized by the Scourge is the dreaded meat wagon (or meatwagon). This rickety contraption is used to collect and store recently slain corpses from the field of battle. At any time, corpses can be pulled from the meat wagon and raised into undead warriors. When upgraded, the meat wagon can also fling diseased corpses at enemy units with its crude catapult device. An invaluable support vehicle for the Scourge, the meat wagon strikes fear and woe into the hearts of even the most resolut

Maybess Riverbreeze is a tauren quest giver located just west of Emerald Sanctuary (on the other side of the road) in Felwood. She was aligned with the Emerald Circle. She started the Cleansing Felwood (Horde) quest chain for Horde players; Alliance looking for this quest were instead directed to Arathandris Silversky to the south. She has been missing since the Cataclysm, her status and whereabouts unknown.
__NOTOC__ Max Xim was a goblin Arena battlemaster located in the Hall of Arms in Ironforge.
__NOTOC__ Maxwort Uberglint is a goblin who used to be located at Flame Crest in the Burning Steppes. After the Cataclysm, he moved into the Blackrock Depths instance.

Mayara Brightwing is a human quest giver located in the hallway leading up to the Grim Guzzler in Blackrock Depths. She asks adventurers to start a fight in the Grim Guzzler to undermine the Dark Irons' morale. Prior to Cataclysm, she was found in the Burning Steppes on behalf of Count Remington Ridgewell, who had sent her to acquire art from the Dark Irons for his family's museum.
Mazra'Alor is the large ziggurat temple located at the heart of Zul'Mashar in the Eastern Plaguelands. It is populated by several forest troll shadow hunters of the Mossflayer tribe.

Mechanical squirrels are, as the name suggests, small robots resembling squirrels. A mechanical squirrel's logic center tells it to collect and store both nuts and bolts for the winter. Considered by most to be a significant improvement to the 4000 series, there were nonetheless serious concerns about the amount of heat produced by the Rabid Nut Varmint 5000.
Me Brother, Nipsy is the second of the two only quests available in the Deeprun Tram; it's a follow-up quest. You must have done Deeprun Rat Roundup to do this one.
Meat vendors, sometimes called 'butchers', sell meaty food that is useful for hunters who have pets with strict diets, such as cats and spiders. General goods vendors also sometimes sell meat.
__NOTOC__ Maxx A. Million Mk. V is a crowd pummeler located at the Ruins of Enkaat in the Netherstorm.
Mechanical or robotic animals are mechanical creatures. Some can be crafted by engineering.
Maxx A. Million Mk. I is a crowd pummeler in the Netherstorm.
Maxx A. Million Mk. II is a crowd pummeler in the Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ The Meat Vendor is a broker located at the Gilded Landing in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market.

A group of night elf hunters caught a goblin tinker merrily working away at southern Ashenvale's trees with his goblin shredder. They kidnapped him and forced him to create an alternative machine to fix the damage he'd done. The mechanical planter (the goblin refused to have his name or his race attached to the device) includes three devices. *Drill: The planter rolls forward on two treads, and a drill goes straight into the earth, forming a planting hole. The drill can go as deep as 5 feet; the driver determines the depth. *Plant: The planter rolls forward 3 feet, and stops while either a seed or a seedling is dropped into the hole. The mechanical planter clears the ground by 3 feet, so it
Mazgrek is a tothrezim rogue. He is a member of a group of tothrezim debt collectors led by Thathrell, maintained for particularly dangerous debt collections.
This is a page listing loot to be found in the Mechanar. For information about the instance itself, see Mechanar.   __TOC__

{{tooltip-wc3 |mode={} |arg={} |name=Mechanical Critter |icon=BTNMechanicalCritter |desc=Creates a mechanical critter. |class=Purchaseable |stock=2 |stockreplenish=60 |sell=25 |hotkey=E }} Creates a player-controlled critter that can be used to scout enemies.
Meadow Ring of Eluding is a world drop commonly used for twinking. This is a sub-type of a random enchantment ring.
McWeaksauce's Meat Tenderizer is a quest reward from Show Gnomercy.
Mayor Godfrey Goodard was once a human mayor of Wintergarde, but was Scourged into a ghoul by the Naxxramas attackers. He is involved in A Righteous Sermon.

Max Blasto is an alarm-o-bot located at Mid Point Station in the Borean Tundra. It is one of the four lieutenants of Gearmaster Mechazod and will spawn when a player tampers with a Mid Point Station Valve.

Mechagnomes (also called mechanognomes, and clockwork mechagnomes) are a race of titan-forged creatures, resembling clockwork machines, who inhabit the Storm Peaks of Northrend. Creations of the titanic watcher Mimiron, they are the ancestors of the gnome race, having been transformed into them after falling victim to the Curse of Flesh.
Mechano-Hog is a chopper vehicle that is created by top Horde engineers. This vehicle allows one party member to ride along in the side-car.
A mechanical dragon, often referred to as dragonlings, is a robot in the form of a dragon whelp created by engineers.
Much like Green Lens and Wild Leather Vest, this item is created with a random enchantment.

Mechanical Greeter RY7R is a crowd pummeler greeter found in front of Ezra Grimm's Premium Tobacco in Old Stratholme. It has been programmed by Ezra Grimm to greet people or let them know if he is not there.
The Meatloaf Pan is provided and used to create Infused Mushroom Meatloaf, for Infused Mushroom Meatloaf (quest).

Mechanical Engineering Guild, Associated is an organization of gnomish engineers. When you choose to specialize yourself with gnome engineering, you automatically become a member of this organization. Any race can become a gnomish engineer.
Me and the Cappin' Makin' it Happen is a player vs. player achievement earned for taking 50 flags in Arathi Basin.
Maz'dinah is a Horde subtlety rogue and is one of the possible opponents for Alliance in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.
Mechagnome Battletanks are gigantic mechano-tanks found while fighting your way through the Formation Grounds in Ulduar.
Mechanical Wand is a quest reward from Bingles' Missing Supplies.

Maximillian of Northshire, nicknamed Max by his beloved Doloria, is a chivalrous (if deluded) human paladin. He was first encountered at the time of the Cataclysm, near the Golakka Hot Springs in Un'Goro Crater, where he strived to save damsels in distress, fight "dragons" and defeat the mother of all devilsaurs with the help of the adventurers as his squires. During the war in Draenor, he traveled to the garrisons of Lunarfall and Frostwall, preparing himself for a quest to kill the "dragons" present in Blackrock Spire. At the time of the third invasion of the Burning Legion, Maximillian left Un'Goro Crater to fight the Burning Legion on the Broken Isles, he was later recruited as a champio
Maziel's Research drops from Murkstone Troggs in Deepholm. It starts Twilight Research.
Mech Control Scrambler is provided as an objective for Core Access Codes (quest).
__NOTOC__ Meara's Dried Roses are found in Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

These 5-inch wooden spheres can be used to set a perimeter around a campsite, or to secure a hallway. A ring mounted on one side can be pulled to extend up to 30 feet of wire, which can be attached to either a spike or another mechanical sentry. When an intruder brushes against the taut wire, a shrill steam whistle inside the mechanical sentry triggers to alert those nearby.
__NOTOC__ Mayor Charlton Connisport is a human quest giver and the mayor of Surwich, in the Blasted Lands.
__NOTOC__ Mechachicken is an oversized mechanical chicken originally part of the Town-In-A-Box package. It was designed to provide food in case of emergencies.

__NOTOC__ Mazzer Stripscrew is a gnome found on the Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge of Thousand Needles. He'll provide Alliance players a River Boat for the quest Pirate Accuracy Increasing. During the Annual Fizzle and Pozzik's Speedbarge Boat Race, Mazzer Stripscrew was the engineer of the Annihilator.
Mazoga's Discarded Coif is a quest reward from Secrets in the Oasis.
__NOTOC__ Mazoga's Spirit is the spirit of Mazoga found at the entrance of Zul'Farrak.

__NOTOC__ Maxx Avalanche is a goblin shaman trainer first encountered near the KTC Headquarters in Kezan. He is later encountered at multiple points in the Lost Isles and finally at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

__NOTOC__ Maziel was an insane Twilight's Hammer clan researcher once called High Cultist Maziel. He was researching the properties of quicksilver and . Apparently, he figured out a way to transform himself into a pure quicksilver elemental and now resides in the Silverlight Cave within the Lower Silvermarsh of Deepholm.

Maybe He'll Get Dizzy... is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating the Spine of Deathwing encounter on Normal or Heroic difficulty after tricking Deathwing into performing the following roll sequence: Left, Right, Left, Right.

Mayhem Reaper Prototypes are reapers found in the starting area of the Horde version Deadmines. Their "maker" is Miss Mayhem. Mayhem tasks players with the task to kill the Foe Reaper 5000 so that she can start selling her reapers to the Horde (since they will be the best without the Foe Reaper 5000 in the way) so that she makes a big profit out of them.
Mecha-Marines Mk. II are crowd pummelers located in Gnomeregan.
Meatface is a hobgoblin found at Land's End Beach in Tanaris.

Meat Grafts are attached to Flesh Horrors in the Butcher's Sanctum of Scholomance and are the primary way of dealing damage to Flesh Horrors. Kill all five of the grafts to instantly kill the flesh horror.
Max Narstave is a pandaren located at Marista in the Krasarang Wilds.
Mayor Shiyo is a pandaren found at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Mazu's Overlook commands a view of Soggy's Gamble, the Shelf of Mazu, and the Briny Muck in southeastern Dread Wastes.
Meadow Marigolds are found in the Sunsoaked Meadow of the Valley of the Four Winds.
__NOTOC__ The Mechanical Pandaren Dragonling is created with Engineering (575); taught by trainers. The Dragonling also has an extremely small chance of being found in Blingtron 4000 Gift Package.

Mayor Honeydew is a pandaren, mayor of Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest. Horde adventurers are asked to convince him to cooperate with the Horde. After a dialogue with Elder Honeypaw, Taran Zhu and Sergeant Gorrok, he decides that the Horde will be allowed to stay in the village to care for the wounded, but that the pandaren will remain neutral.
Max Boomson is a goblin located at Fuselight-by-the-Sea in the Badlands. He appears to be working on schematics.
Mazhareen is the fourth encounter at Rank 3 of the Brawler's Guild.
Max Megablast is a goblin who runs G.G. Engineering together with Bo Bobble.

:"MEATBALL HUNGRY!!" Meatball is the final encounter at Rank 4 in the Brawler's Guild. He also becomes a follower as well as a champion for class orders. He can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul. Meatball acted as a bailiff during :The Brawlpub Trial and :The Brawl'gar Trial. He is found within Torghast, Tower of the Damned. If one frees him and suceeds in slaying Meatball's Tormentor, he will join the player's covenant as a champion.
Maziel's Journal is a diary located at Twilight Overlook in Deepholm. It belonged to Maziel.
Meatpie is an ogre located at the Suntouched Pillar in Sholazar Basin.
Mayor Lin is a pandaren found at Greenstone Village of Jade Forest, but only during the scenario. She is the mayor of the village.
__NOTOC__ The Mechanical Axebeak is crafted with Engineering (1); taught by Schematic: Mechanical Axebeak.
Maximo is a pandaren child located with Noah at the Gong of Hope in the Jade Forest.
Mazdon Bizratchet is a goblin blacksmithing trainer and vendor found behind Gallywix's Garage in Warspear of Ashran.
Maximillian's Laundry is a quest reward from Damsels and Dragons.
Mecha-Blast Rocket is created with Engineering (1); taught by Draenor Engineering (item). It can also be obtained from the Blingtron 5000 Gift Package rewarded from Blingtron 5000 (quest).
__NOTOC__ The Mechanical Scorpid is created with Engineering (1); taught by Schematic: Mechanical Scorpid.

Maxwell Wiggins was a Gilnean newspaper owner. Halford Ramsey believed he was a member of the Wolf Cult. Later this was confirmed when Halford follows that he produced the Purity of Essence from his printing press for the Wolf Cult.
__NOTOC__ Meadowstomper Calf is a quest reward from New Babies.
Mecha Plunderer is a smaller iron juggernaut located at the Lost Veil Anzu in Spires of Arak.

__NOTOC__ Meatgut is an ogre quest giver and vendor located at the in . He sells some food and water, but once his quest becomes unlocked his wares normally become unavailable. His repeatable quest awards either experience points (if the player is below level 100) or money (if the player is max level). His quest may be done unlimited times a day.

Mean and Green is an achievement earned from reach 10 stacks of Mutagen in the Everbloom Wilds, Gorgrond. Killing the infected orcs in the area will spawn green pools underneath their corpses, of which the player must stand in to get the Mutagen debuff. The player must be wary of the increasing damage taken from the stacks, so apply healing when necessary.
McCarty's Notes drops from Quartermaster McCarty in the Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.
Maz Siam is the voice of General Husam in World of Warcraft.

Maywiki's Fetish is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Eliminate the Outcast (Alliance) *High Priest Venoxis (Alliance) *High Priestess Jeklik (Alliance) *Plunging Into Zul'Gurub (Alliance) *Through the Troll Hole (Alliance)
Mazgoroth is an annihilan appearing during the battle for the Broken Shore. Later, he also appears at Legion Invasion locations, acting as a Legion commander and attacking the regional capitals.
Mechanized Lumber Extractor is a reward for completing the Collections achievement Remember to Share.
Mechano-Peeps are small mechanostriders summoned by Gnomeregan Mechano-Mages to fight against the Burning Legion during the Legion Invasions.
Mechagnome Curators appear in the Antechamber of Ulduar during the quest The Diamond King. They politely inform visitors that certain parts of the facility are inaccessible.
__NOTOC__ Max Crits is a Forsaken rogue located at the Hall of Shadows in Dalaran.
Max Mittelman is a voice actor who has provided several voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
Meaty Racks of Musken Ribs are looted from Sixtrigger Resource Crate as a quest reward from Time to Collect which begins with Gazrix Gearlock in Dalaran.
The McWeaksauces are a family of human NPCs often associated with beta testing. "Cookie" McWeaksauce is the only one who really exists within the lore.
Mecha-Bond Imprint Matrix teaches hunters to tame and track mechanical beasts.
Meaty Racks of Musken Ribs drop from Stout Highlands Runehorns in Stormheim.

Mayor Striggs was the mayor of Glenbrook Homestead. Judging by the description of Abby Lewis, he was always running away from the town's problems. His whereabouts are unknown, but by Abby's words he is deceased. Abby also named a doll after him.

, a mechanical wolf]] Mechanical wolves or mechanowolves are mechanical creatures introduced in World of Warcraft: Legion. Isaac Blastimov and Bamm Megabomb jointly invented them. There are four of them that can be tamed, each a different color.
